title: WIP of my spiritual successor to my favorite Civ5 mod
author: BladesBurden

comments.author: BladesBurden
comments.body:
One of my comfort games has always been Civ5, and my favorite mod (Faerun) turns the city building experience into a party-based RPG. I've spent hundreds of hours replaying this campaign, but it is a bit linear from a single-player perspective.

So that was my motivation for working on this project. Recreating that party-based feel, but aiming for having a bit more replayability passed the single-player campaigns. Aiming for local and online co-op down the line for the official release.

I'm building it in Unity, using Claude via MCP.
